final_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: wide cover illustration for a Chinese technology blog, aspect ratio 2.35:1. Theme: clean up accumulated coding-agent instructions while preserving clear boundaries and completion goals. Summary angle: an agile editor cuts loose tangled redundant paper ribbons, leaving three concise route cards and a clear finish marker. Narrative flow: conflict-to-resolution, left to right. One dominant focal subject: a single focused martial-arts scholar at a wooden workbench, making one sweeping brush gesture that separates a tangled mass of unlettered paper scrolls on the left into an orderly small set of reference cards in the center; a simple finish pennant within a deliberate boundary on the right. Three source-grounded information beats: excessive skill descriptions become concise scope, reference guidance is loaded only when needed, completion boundary stays clear. Allow exactly three small Chinese labels: 「精简指令」「按需读取」「明确终点」 placed near those three beats, no other text. Composition: panoramic editorial scene with dominant scholar and sweeping ink arc, cards and boundary secondary, ample clear space, readable at thumbnail size. Style/medium: conceptual editorial illustration combined with bold martial-arts comic look, expressive ink strokes, dramatic stances, gritty texture, strong motion arcs. Palette: warm ivory, ink black, muted brick red, restrained golden ochre. Polished graphic ink rendering, no imitation of specific artists or brands. No poster title, hero slogan, long sentences, English slogans, sound effects, watermark, prompt residue, UI screenshots, dashboards, fake diagrams, chart axes, terminal output, fabricated metrics, architecture node names, unrelated icon collage, floating chips, code rain, neon skyscrapers, robots, purple-blue glow, HUD overlays or decorative clutter.
